findings.explanation: Detailed implementation has a brief 5-step list followed by a full duplicate set of generic template steps.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk Enterprise — Splunk Add-on for Cisco Security (Splunkbase 1352)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=netflow into network. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Consolidate into a single coherent implementation guide for NetFlow IPv6 anycast monitoring.

summary: Damaged by title salad fragments, duplicated boilerplate implementation steps, and formulaic false-positive templates.
